about.title: From Texas to the World
about.subheading: Born from Texan standards and refined by Portuguese craftsmanship, we build with control at every stage.
body: Longhorn Construction handles architecture, planning and full execution with an in house team covering groundworks, structure and finishes. Timelines stay predictable, costs stay transparent and quality remains consistent.

With owned machinery and coordinated crews, we remove delays caused by subcontractors. This end to end control is why homeowners and investors across the Algarve and Vicentine Coast trust us to deliver reliable, high quality work.
bullets: Full in house workflow from conception to completion
Owned machinery for speed, efficiency and site control
Consistent quality across the Algarve and Vicentine Coast
Expertise in traditional masonry, Light Steel Frame and ICF systems

section.title: We are experts in...
section.intro: Three structural progressive systems that we know inside out. We help you pick the right one for your project.

traditional.label: Traditional
traditional.excerpt: Classic reinforced concrete and masonry structures, executed with strict control over quality, budget, and schedule.

icf.label: ICF
icf.excerpt: Insulated concrete wall systems that combine speed of execution with excellent thermal and acoustic performance.

lsf.label: LSF
lsf.excerpt: Light steel framing for precise, dry, and efficient construction with clean sites and predictable timelines.

services.title: Our services
services.intro: One team, end to end. We self-perform each stage to keep quality high and schedules tight.

items.title: Design-build support
items.desc: Early constructability input, budget guidance, and coordination with your architect and engineer.

items.title: Groundworks and foundations
items.desc: Earthworks, footings, drainage, and slab work with owned equipment for speed and precision.

items.title: ICF structural shell
items.desc: Panel supply and installation, concrete pours, and structural integration for fast, robust envelopes.

items.title: Masonry and concrete
items.desc: Blockwork, reinforced concrete elements, retaining walls, and architectural finishes.

items.title: Roofing and envelope
items.desc: Framing, waterproofing, insulation, and exterior finishes for long-term performance.

items.title: MEP coordination
items.desc: Mechanical, electrical, and plumbing coordination with clear routes and clean penetrations.

items.title: Interior finishes
items.desc: Plaster, tile, flooring, carpentry, and painting with consistent, supervised craftsmanship.

items.title: Renovations and additions
items.desc: Careful upgrades and extensions that respect structure, schedule, and budget.

items.title: Site logistics and equipment
items.desc: Owned machinery, certified operators, and tidy sites that keep crews efficient and safe.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: We have answers to all your questions.

items.q: Do you work only with Sismo?
items.a: We build with Sismo where it adds value, and we also deliver traditional methods. We recommend the best approach for your budget, schedule, and performance goals.
We primarily serve the Algarve. For larger projects we consider work across Portugal.

items.q: How fast is ICF compared to traditional builds?
items.a: Sismo panels install rapidly and reduce coordination steps. Actual gains depend on design and site logistics, but schedules are typically shorter than traditional masonry.
No. We self-perform with our own team and equipment, which helps us control quality, safety, and timelines.

items.q: Can you help before I have a full project set?
items.a: Yes. We offer early design-build support to validate assumptions, align budgets, and surface constructability issues before they become costly.
Yes. We maintain the appropriate registrations and insurance. We can share documentation during preconstruction.
Send a short brief and any drawings you have. We will schedule a call or site visit and provide next steps with a clear plan.
Yes. We stand behind our workmanship and the systems we install. Specific terms depend on the project scope and materials.
